help.introHint: Open the user guide for beginner-friendly walkthroughs, limitations, and troubleshooting.
help.quickStart.title: Quick start
help.quickStart.step1: Import a resource pack (.zip) using the Import button.
help.quickStart.step2: Search and select a JSON UI file, then select a definition within that file.
help.quickStart.step3: Use the left tree to select/reorder elements, and the right panel to edit properties.
help.quickStart.step4: Use the Canvas tab to preview, then validate and export when ready.
help.docs.title: Documents
help.troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
help.troubleshooting.preview: If the Preview tab shows a placeholder, use the Canvas tab (current renderer).
help.troubleshooting.vanillaWarnings: Vanilla HUD screens often use templates/inheritance/dynamic values. Validation focuses on this editor’s supported subset and may show warnings.
help.troubleshooting.mobile: Mobile editing is best-effort. PC/Chrome is recommended for large packs.
preview.placeholder.p1: Preview is currently provided via the Canvas tab.
preview.placeholder.bullet1: Use Canvas for layout boxes, zoom/pan, and selection.
preview.placeholder.bullet2: Some vanilla files use dynamic values (“$var”, “#binding”, “@...”) that are preserved but not always evaluatable.
preview.placeholder.bullet3: Use Diagnostics to review validation results (errors block export; warnings do not).
preview.placeholder.hint: See Help → User guide for limitations and troubleshooting.

logs.session.hint: Records site activity between Start and Stop with a 512 KiB limit. Pack and file bodies are never collected. User-Agent and console are captured only when explicitly selected.
logs.context.title: Environment, version, preview context & advanced tools
logs.context.hint: Shows the selected UI, scale, resolution, Vanilla readiness, layout, and binding statistics without pack bodies.
logs.renderErrorHint: A render error occurred. Open Logs & diagnostics for details.
